**Geographic focus:**

**Temporal focus:**
T1. Historical report [NO]
T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES]
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [YES]

**Synopsis:**
Markets are focused on Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech, with attention on inflation and policy direction. Warsh is expected to underwhelm on forward guidance, while a tension between him and Treasury Secretary Bessent over the role of market-driven pricing versus active policy tools adds institutional friction. Elevated Treasury yields reflect lingering doubts about the Fed's inflation-fighting credibility. Broader "fiscal dominance" concerns — where ballooning debt pressures blur the line between fiscal and monetary policy — add longer-term structural risk. European and French inflation data also in focus.
